title: —EGO CREDO UT VITA PAUPERUM EST SIMPLICITER ATROX, SIMPLICITER SANGUINARIUS ATROX, IN LIVERPOOLIO
html_source:
Latin,
I believe that the life of the poor is simply atrocious, simply bloody atrocious, in Liverpool
